primary.title: Primary fee
primary.description: A required monthly fee calculated automatically for each property: fee value × number of active residents. Each property can have only one primary fee.

monthly.title: Monthly fee
monthly.description: A non-primary fee charged every month. You can choose how many times it is applied to the property.

oneTime.title: One-time fee
oneTime.description: A non-primary fee charged only when it is Active. Mark it Inactive when it should no longer be included.

monthlyFeeInfo:
Determines whether the fee is charged
monthly or one-time.
Monthly fees are charged every month, while one-time fees are charged only once.
This setting can be changed at any time.

billInfo.title: Bills
billInfo.description: Bills are records of condominium expenses that can be added, renamed, or deleted.
billInfo.note: The bill limit is configured by the administrator.

primaryFeeInfo.title: Primary Fee
primaryFeeInfo.description: The primary fee is applied monthly and is calculated based on the number of active residents in the property.
